narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Any eight numbers will make a good puzzle, because I write them in the squares.
<bookmark mark='top'/>In Chintu's ring the top side adds up to eight.
<bookmark mark='left'/>But the left side adds up to seventeen, so no single border sum exists.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Numbers written without a plan cannot make a puzzle that has an answer.

narration: <bookmark mark='sheet'/>Keep the full grid as your answer sheet, and check your friends' answers against it.
